objective: Remove the known mathematically sharp front corners from the generated aluminum sill tray without changing drainage dimensions, then keep the same physical edge-break geometry in the already-referenced combined LOD1/2/3 proxies and freeze that mesh state into the formal reflection evidence epoch.
priorityRationale: The preceding sill run explicitly left the custom tray cross-section as a native-4K risk because its exposed front edges had no millimetric bevel. A razor edge can create an implausibly thin or unstable grazing highlight and directly harms Geometry/Construction, Material/PBR and Cinematic image plausibility. Because visible LOD pop is also a critical automatic FAIL, refining only LOD0 would be insufficient; the combined far proxy must carry the same edge geometry before any new decorative asset is added.

commitsBeforeRunRecord.message: visual: add physical sill tray edge-break refinement

implementation.manufactureReasoning: Treats the existing fallback sill as an extruded/anodized aluminum profile. Hydro custom-extrusion guidance states that razor-sharp extrusion corners cannot be achieved and rounded corners are more practical. The exact 2 mm edge break is explicitly a benchmark reconstruction assumption rather than an identified historic product dimension.
implementation.geometry: Replaces the four-point tray depth profile with a six-point convex profile. The weather-facing front-top and front-bottom corners each receive a 2 mm physical chamfer while the outer front/back/top/bottom envelope, 2.460 m sill width, lower-frame seat, drain recess and drain opening positions remain unchanged.
implementation.lodContinuity: After each used phase-specific LOD0 tray asset is refined, the existing shared GM_FacadeSill_CombinedProxy_P* asset is rebuilt from SillTray + Skirt_Left + Skirt_Center + Skirt_Right + DripNose in assembly-local space. LOD1/2/3 continue to share that one proxy asset, so the front-edge break does not disappear at a cross-fade.
implementation.material: No new material or highlight texture. Refined faces inherit canonical MAT_AgedAluminum and the existing mapped metallic 0.82-0.94, roughness 0.43-0.55, tangent-space microstructure, metric UV phase and wetness=0 policy.
implementation.weathering: No new stain source is invented. Existing RainLedge, DrainRunoff and UVExposure metadata remains authoritative; the chamfer is geometry only.
implementation.evidenceBinding: The sill reflection-binding contract is schema 1.2. Formal preparation runs the deterministic edge refinement before the sill reflection epoch is armed. A separate SessionState SHA-256 mesh fingerprint covers persisted used tray/proxy assets and is read-only after arm, including across script/assembly reloads. QA4K/QATemporal MainCamera pre-cull also rejects an unarmed or drifted refinement.
implementation.lookdev: Added a technical SVG showing the two 2 mm front edge breaks, preserved envelope/interfaces, inherited PBR values and frontal/oblique/grazing/temporal pixel checks.

sourceBasis.external: Hydro custom aluminum extrusion design guidance reviewed 2026-09-12: razor-sharp corners cannot be achieved in custom extrusions and rounded corners are more practical.
sourceBasis.scopeLimit: The source supports removing the mathematical knife edge as a manufacturing principle only. It does not establish a 2 mm radius/chamfer for a specific 1990s Japanese sash, so 2 mm remains an authored reconstruction assumption.
